- **Copyable image history** — the rig"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ht panel records the current DSH model's final answer beside each image thumbnail, with expandable h"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"istory and one-click copy.
- **Plugin-owned video upload** — accepts MP4, M4V, MOV, AVI, MPG/MPEG, M"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"KV, and WebM only when extension, signature, and FFprobe agree.
- **Scene-aware video analysis** — n"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"ormalizes to H.264/yuv420p MP4, extracts keyframes with PySceneDetect, and sends ordered timestamped"},{"id":"p9s7","text":" images to the current DSH vision model.
- **Right-side panel** — switch between image/video views, "},{"id":"p9s8","text":"play normalized videos directly, and stage a selected video in the chat draft.
- **Advanced video se"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"ttings** — tune upload size, storage quota, duration, output size, FPS, CRF, and keyframe count from"},{"id":"p9s10","text":" the plugin settings card."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The plugin never rewrites model messages or calls a private vision endpoint.
